title: Bluetooth: Register Bluetooth UUID type
description:
Use the UUID type handling interface for Bluetooth.  Replace the tree of UUIDs (strings) with a hash table keyed by the UUID itself.
Make it clearer which structure is then used to convert UAT data into the hashed UUID values

This hash doesn't work because for the 16-bit UUIDs the other 14 bytes of bt_uuid->data are not initialized. (Rather than being initialized to zero, or alternatively the data storing the full UUID with the other bytes taken from the Bluetooth Base UUID used for the 16 bit ones.)
So you recommend using bt_uuid and size members?

I think (but I might need to check the code to be sure) that

`wmem_strong_hash(bt_uuid->data, bt_uuid->size)` would work.
